body:
## Reproduction
At 1920×1080, open `?renderer=oblique`, create/pause a prison, select Build and arm Brick wall, expand Minimap, then drag with the middle mouse button across the world canvas.

## Actual
The minimap viewport remains exactly `left: 2.38975%; top: 2.38975%; width: 95.2205%; height: 95.2205%`. The angled scene ignores button 1 even though the Build hint promises that the middle button moves the camera. The top-down scene already implements middle-drag pan.

## Expected
Middle drag pans the angled camera while preserving the world ground point under the pointer, without placing a wall or triggering browser autoscroll. RMB rotation and left-button construction remain distinct. The pan ends on pointerup/out/cancel, blur and prison-session replacement.

## Evidence
`tests/browser/oblique-middle-pan.spec.ts` red on production at Full HD, one browser worker, 5.7 s test. The test expands Minimap because Build collapses its panel by default, then checks its real camera viewport after physical middle drag.
title: Middle mouse drag does not pan oblique camera while Build is armed
